speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Small beer. Drink it before you are brave. I am giving you my blessing on the road, and the blessing is not a plot, and it is not a second receipt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll take the beer and the blessing. I leave in the morning. I will not ask you to improve either.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then go to the church like a man whose quarter is paid, and leave the improving to the road. The beer is the end of what I have to give you today.
